summary: High-Trend International Group (HTCO) filed a Form 6-K disclosing the full repayment of a $3.23M note to Streeterville Capital, LLC and termination of the related securities purchase agreement. In exchange, 630,000 Class A ordinary shares originally eligible for resale on May 1, 2026 were returned to the company for cancellation. The company also sold a $2.6M unsecured promissory note at 5% interest to its controller Jinyu Chang. This retires the financing overhang and reduces future trading float. Watch for Nasdaq compliance and any further share retirement or balance sheet improvements.
